sound — light analogy) the arrow-like rays of the planet Venus as morning star can no longer be seen

p.src:
On the high turret sitting lone,
She waked at times the lute’s soft tone;
Touch’d a wild note, and all between
Thought of the bower of hawthorns green.
 Her golden hair stream’d free from band,
Her fair cheek rested on her hand,
Her blue eyes sought the west afar,
For lovers love the western star. (9–16)
